title: BMV issuer profile — Grupo Hotelero Santa Fe (holdout)
text: GRUPO HOTELERO SANTA FE, S.A.B. DE C.V. Clave: HOTEL. Grupo Hotelero Santa Fe is a Mexican company dedicated to the acquisition, development and operation of hotels. Krystal Grand Puerto Vallarta appears in the owned portfolio listing of Grupo Hotelero Santa Fe. Portfolio listing alone is weaker than explicit property ownership language in the annual report.
